stage: Held-out source-family transfer of frozen source-bound checker; custom deterministic adapter, not native evaluator audit
selection: Join official dev row with same-index one-based label. Sort SHA256 of UTF8 canonical JSON {record:raw,label:integer} with sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,separators comma/colon; tie original index; first min(100,N). No substitutions, errors retained.
adapter: Context newline question is source_question; answerA/B/C exact source_choices; label1/2/3 maps to zero-based source index. Prompt is context newline question newline A/B/C options newline instruction. Source-gold exact text and aligned letter reference. Independently measured question and required-context nonce substitution probes.
record_policy: Run every selected row/condition once; retain unknown schemas, unavailable labels, non-applicable mutations and exceptions. Freeze all source/adapter/checker bytes before evaluation. No post-outcome fixes in this stage.
acquisition: One request to each pinned loader/archive; preserve errors and no alternate corpus. No credentials. Official archive checksum required. No source row or label preview before protocol commit.
units: Report source rows, unique source questions, shared context groups and condition variants separately. Reused failure mechanisms; source-family holdout does not equal fault-family holdout. Healthy adapter controls are not proven natural framework behavior.
statistics: Descriptive counts only. No deployment prevalence, population precision or model accuracy estimates.
exposure_limit: Bounded documentary exposure review, not a complete row-level hash census of every earlier project package or private executor. Claim is held-out from documented checker development; do not claim globally blind independent validation.
